rules.description: The default dark ink used at the root level of the document, establishing the baseline for text readability.
The primary light theme surface and inverse text color, providing a crisp backdrop and high-contrast typography in dark sections.
when_to_use: Typography and form inputs over dark media sections

rules.description: Used for active swiper pagination bullets
A warm, mid-tone grey that separates specific content sections and serves as subdued ink for secondary elements.
when_to_use: Secondary text and copyright links in the footer
Delicate separator border in the footer

rules.description: A pure black primarily used with alpha transparency to create softened, sophisticated overlays for typography and UI controls.
when_to_use: Header navigation links and floating deposit text (at 72% opacity)

rules.description: A deep charcoal grey used as a solid backdrop behind full-screen, media-heavy robot showcases.
when_to_use: Background for the main 'NEO Home Robot' image section
Background for the 'Experience NEO' video section

insights: The design system is heavily monochromatic and relies on stark contrasts to let the product photography and videos be the sole source of vibrant color.
Opacity is a core architectural tool: pure black is consistently washed to 72% opacity for headings, nav links, and buttons to soften the harshness of high-contrast design.

There is a deliberate temperature shift in the dark surfaces, contrasting the neutral Charcoal (#222222) of the product sections with the warmer Gamma Grey (#4F4749) of the corporate 'Careers' section.
